Since 0.1.5. The major version stays 0.

### Play
Foldcade finds emulator save folders on its own (#332). A folder it already holds, such as a library folder, can cover a player's saves, so a launch that finds one starts with no dialog. A folder you picked stays the one it uses.

Settings › Emulators › Find saves is optional all-files access (#333). Turn it on and save folders on shared storage set themselves up. Leave it off and saves still sync from folders you pick.

Set up saves is one guided page for every emulator (#334). A save notice on R1 opens it, and so does Settings › Emulators › Set up saves. Signing in to a new RomM server opens it when a step is still left. Left and right move. Confirm does the step. X skips for this time only. A folder found without asking shows as Saves found, with the emulator and the path. When Eden has no user yet, the page and R1 ask you to add one.

### Home
Take a platform folder off Home with Y › Remove. The games stay, and the hint reads Off Home · Y Undo. L1 › Edit home › Folders lists every folder Foldcade makes (#335). A folder off Home is dimmed. Y opens an On Home switch, and A still opens the folder so you can play. Find lists those folders too.

L1 Games is now a searchable All games library (#336). L1 is Home, Games, and Apps. Games, and the Home tile, open All games: every game, on every system. Tabs are All, Recent, Most played, Not on Home, and one tab per system. L2 and R2 step the tabs. Select, or Find, searches. Y › Add to › Home pins a game. The tabs replace Settings › Library › Sort All.

### Fixes
On Settings › Library › RomM › Edit connection, Up and Down move between fields while Gboard is open (#337). Down from Server reaches Client API token. Up from an edited token returns to Server.

The release asset is `foldcade.apk`.

### Known issues
- The Thor hardware checklist is open. A green emulator run is not a Thor pass. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/43
- GameNative's own library is not imported. Foldcade reads exported `.steam` files only. It does not read GameNative's private database. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/100
- Android games launched from Foldcade don't record play history, so they don't appear in Recent or Most played.
